scope: Saved baseline, tuned, and burst3 recording identity cross-check; read-only source trace
finding: The earlier reported stimulus/tracking dimension swap came from a reversed summary inventory. It is not reproduced by the retained run artifacts. Session configuration, encoded files, camera identity tags, and sampled native encoder session dimensions agree.

correction.prior_inference: Stimulus 2560x2000 and tracking 1588x1344 were interpreted as swapped relative to renderer/tracking native sessions.
correction.verified_interpretation: Renderer review is 2560x2000; tracking camera is 1588x1344. The baseline native PID ancestry and encoder-session dimensions support that mapping.

baseline.evidence: run.json checks.gpu_samples, nvidia-smi encodersessions on GPU-4d9915eb-bf04-59a8-8811-e0779366a0dc
baseline.process_ancestry_evidence: recording-processes.json maps renderer PID 14640 to FFmpeg PID 15848; acquisition PID 9048 to FFmpeg PID 30860; acquisition PID 32280 to FFmpeg PID 34164.
baseline.assessment: PID dimensions and parent roles align with saved tracking, renderer review, and behavioral outputs respectively.

tuned.evidence: tuned/run.json checks.gpu_samples, nvidia-smi encodersessions on GPU-4d9915eb-bf04-59a8-8811-e0779366a0dc
tuned.assessment: Native dimensions align with actual tuned MP4 dimensions; a tuned per-PID parent-process snapshot was not retained.

burst3.evidence: burst3/run.json checks.gpu_samples, nvidia-smi encodersessions on GPU-4d9915eb-bf04-59a8-8811-e0779366a0dc
burst3.assessment: Native dimensions align with actual burst3 MP4 dimensions; native samples are bounded snapshots, not complete command-line records.

source_trace.acquisition: src/cephvr/acquisition/recording/session_schedule.py resolves paths by role and identity, builds argv from that role's CameraImageLayout width/height and video_path, and launches the same argv. src/cephvr/shared/supervised_encoder.py passes that argv to launch_suspended and binds the same output_path to the exact returned child owner.
source_trace.visual_stimulus: src/cephvr/visual_stimulus/recording/encoding.py builds rawvideo argv with -s composite_width x composite_height and the requested output path. src/cephvr/visual_stimulus/recording/encoder_owner.py passes that argv and output_path to the shared launcher; periodic sync checks the held file identity remains stable.
source_trace.source_review_result: No cross-role output-path or cached encoder-handle substitution was found in the inspected launch path.

validation_limitations: Elevated ffprobe was run read-only on baseline and tuned stimulus/tracking files. burst3 disk probing had already been captured by its verification.json and prior elevated read-only check.

Saved native session samples report PID, codec, dimensions, frame rate, and latency; they do not preserve the exact historical argv. The baseline process ancestry and the source launch path provide the PID-role join, while actual on-disk output dimensions and camera tags independently agree.
No source change, test, or hardware action was performed for this assessment.
